[Wed 2026-05-20 09:55 UTC] Combine the relevant history lines and log snippets into a single log file.
I’ll compile the matches into a workspace file, including the fact that history search had no matching lines, then commit it.

arguments.command:
out='/root/.openclaw/workspace/combined-history-log-snippets.log'; {
  echo '# Combined history lines and /var/log snippets'
  echo '# Generated: 2026-05-20 09:55 UTC'
  echo
  echo '## History files searched'
  hist_files=$(find /root /home -type f \( -name '.bash_history' -o -name '.zsh_history' -o -name '.python_history' -o -name '*_history' \) 2>/dev/null | sort)
  if [ -z "$hist_files" ]; then
    echo 'No history files found.'
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$hist_files" | sed 's/^/- /'
  fi
  echo
  echo "## History matches for: sudo|ftp|login"
  if [ -z "$hist_files" ]; then
    echo '(not searched; no history files found)'
  else
    any=0
    printf '%s\n' "$hist_files" | while IFS= read -r f; do
      matches=$(grep -nEi 'sudo|ftp|login' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [ -n "$matches" ]; then
        echo "== $f =="
        printf '%s\n' "$matches"
        any=1
      fi
    done
    # Re-check because while loop may run in subshell.
    if ! printf '%s\n' "$hist_files" | xargs -r grep -nEi 'sudo|ftp|login' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo '(no matches)'
    fi
  fi
  echo
  echo '## /var/log files searched'
  log_files=$(find /var/log -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name 'syslog*' -o -name 'messages*' -o -name 'kern.log*' -o -name 'auth.log*' -o -name 'daemon.log*' -o -name 'debug*' -o -name 'dmesg*' \) -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort)
  if [ -z "$log_files" ]; then
    echo 'No matching log files found.'
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$log_files" | sed 's/^/- /'
  fi
  echo
  echo '## /var/log snippets matching: debug|error|fail|warn|critical|panic|segfault|denied'
  if [ -z "$log_files" ]; then
    echo '(not searched; no log files found)'
  else
    matches=$(printf '%s\n' "$log_files" | xargs -r grep -nEai 'debug|error|fail|warn|critical|panic|segfault|denied' 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$matches" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$matches"
    else
      echo '(no matches)'
    fi
  fi
} > "$out"
printf 'Wrote %s\n' "$out"

git status --short

git add combined-history-log-snippets.log && git commit -m 'Add combined history and log snippets'
